points.description: Defines noise as random fluctuations/irregular variations in the time series data, about (or superimposed on) its typical/underlying pattern or trend.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vague (e.g. 'unwanted disturbance' or 'variation in data') without stating randomness or relation to the typical pattern.

points.description: States the two types of noise: white noise and red noise.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one type is correctly named.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the idea of random fluctuations around the usual pattern, plus both noise types named (white and red). Give part marks for a vague definition or for naming only one type. Give no marks for wrong or unrelated ideas; a wrong type does not affect the definition point.
